title: North-star continuation through1680: pure-cheat correction, hub roles and local compatibility
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

ids: many-world consideration9;access/research/events/quests;knowledge/ambitions;world stance+hubs/heavens;other protagonists/harmful cheats;pure cheats/knacks/collisions;rewind first-view/Jumpchain;compatibility modes;aptitude;tech worlds/other world types;superpower digest opening
reviews.classification: cumulative north-star opening1680 lines; pure-cheat correction, decomposed stance and local tech/source claims
reviews.disposition:
Continuation of B444's partial review: original lines1–1,080 remain unchanged (the original7,761-line prefix matches B444's input SHA); another600 lines,1,081–1,680, were freshly read. Cumulative coverage is1–1,680, still partial. The remainder1,681–7,761 and appended reconciliation notices remain open. This range ends during the superpower-world source digest, so that section is not treated as complete.

**The actual pure-cheat correction is present.** The earlier clean-cheat paragraph still suggests outside limits are needed to keep power fair, but the following user-directed “Pure cheats and absolute knacks” section explicitly permits no price, including no hidden price, and overpowered knacks. Its rarity, narrow-scope, hostile reaction or exclusion-list examples do not create compulsory replacement drawbacks. Exceptionless cheats remain available. The initial rewind-farming list is expressly a first view whose costs are later revised; it does not require soul wear, diminishing rewards, increasingly hostile worlds or detectable loops. Detection, carry, reward renewal and repeat settlement follow actual mechanisms. Neither the old Jumpchain pushback preference nor world-card absences can force a counter just because a combination becomes strong. [Current direction](USER_VISION.md) and [cheat cosmology](CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md) retain the owning rules.

The knack table is illustrative, not a complete logical specification. Remembering a face does not by its wording alone sense a disguised current face; knowing a route does not necessarily create an absent traversable route; knowing time does not automatically manipulate it. Define the actual power's reach, target and operation, including genuinely absolute or broader versions, rather than replacing mechanisms with either free automatic extrapolation or a narrow permission list. The within-range power-scaling correction already rejects a universal higher-tier-wins collision table while permitting a world to choose one.

**World stance and hubs are decomposed by the document itself.** Favored/neutral/suppressed/rejected/leashed/expansionist labels are shorthand for distinct world will, law, environmental fit, sponsor and institutional relationships. The later hubs/heavens digest corrects the single-world-opinion picture, keeps tactics scene-specific and explicitly leaves quitting/switching prices unknown. Those fees are authored possibilities, not newly verified canon. Home, employer, patron, referee and portal owner can be different actors. Strong powers, independent travelers and outsiders do not automatically incur attention, costs, suppression or hostility without a real channel and motive. Future knowledge does not reveal itself to every regressor by default. Machine-translated source notes and dated complete-reading assertions retain their stated uncertainty; no actual hub/source dossier was reopened here.

**Access and growth distinctions are useful defaults.** Hear/learn/qualify/attempt, rumor/belief/confirmation and research/practice/execution separate meaningful causes, but a direct grant, discovery by action, inherited faculty, memory or other actual means may connect or bypass stages. “Nothing appears before heard of” does not hide ordinary comfort controls or forbid experimenting before understanding. Remembered knowledge can include real answers where carried; it is not restricted to vague flashes. A suggested ambition remains optional rather than an imposed player motive. The five compatibility modes describe useful outcomes, not mandatory conversion steps or monotonic practice progress; a power may simply work, and actual changed laws can revise compatibility in other ways.

**Tech/source proposals stay local.** Knowledge, design, manufacture and operation distinguish problems for a crafted device, but not every made power needs four separate unlock gates. The Legendary Mechanic's anti-repeat XP, paid knowledge/talent changes, control limits and economic upkeep remain the dated digest's source-specific assertions and original adaptation leads. They do not impose anti-grind hardening, guaranteed repeated costs or a declining benefit on ordinary YAIR skills, genuine repeated production or new learning. “Power outside the body” describes a tech-world tendency, not the absence of cyborg/body-integrated/other power paths listed in the same range. The superpower digest has only begun here; no whole-world, whole-source or current code/readiness conclusion is drawn. Keep source claims, proposed world cards and actual implementation separate. No new source reading, acquisition, lane, gameplay, test/build/browser or persistence proof was performed.
